items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: George Bernard Shaw said, “Two nations divided by a common language,”

ctx.x: About 999 too many perhaps. No I think there’s always, look, there is what is called a special relationship. We are close to each other in many ways. That’s not to say that we think alike. George Bernard Shaw said, “Two nations divided by a common language,” and there is still something of that. But I think we feel pretty comfortable with the relationship I guess.
If you got an assignment to write about someone who has been written about a lot, could you envision how you would find your own angle to get at this person?
